description: Stationnement 2 roues à Issy-les-Moulineaux is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Localisation des aires de stationnement pour véhicules 2 roues (pour les motos et les vélos) sur le territoire d'Issy-les-Moulineaux. Une aire de stationnement est un espace dédié au stationnement des véhicules 2 roues (vélos et ou motos). Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are 2 roues motorisées, 2 roues, vélo, moto, parking, issy.com. The portal shows 406 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
